description: Run a .mob test case on a device. The case_path is relative to the project directory. Pass params to supply values for ${name} substitution in the script.

case_path.description: Relative path to the .mob file within the project, e.g. auth/login.mob

device_id.description: Device ID to run the test on

params.description: Optional key-value parameters for ${name} substitution in the script

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the project directory

name: test_run
